description: This file defines the Employee class, which extends from Person and represents employee entities within the SuiteCRM system. It includes properties for employee details, methods for retrieving and manipulating employee data, access control, and query generation specific to employee records.

classes.name: Employee
classes.description: Represents an employee, extending from Person, with employee-specific properties and behaviors, including access control, data retrieval, and query customization within the SuiteCRM framework.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns a formatted summary text for the employee, primarily the name.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_list_fields
methods.description: Fills in additional fields for list views, such as reports-to name and messenger info.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Populates detailed related employee data, such as the reports-to employee name.

methods.name: retrieve_employee_id
methods.description: Retrieves the employee ID based on a given username.

methods.name: verify_data
methods.description: Performs data verification; simplified here to always return true.

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Prepares and returns data for list views, including related fields and status.

methods.name: list_view_parse_additional_sections
methods.description: Allows parsing or modification of additional list sections (stub implementation).

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Generates an SQL query to export employee data with proper ordering and filtering.

methods.name: create_new_list_query
methods.description: Creates a list query string for retrieving employee records, filtering out portal-only users.

methods.name: hasCustomFields
methods.description: Checks if the Employee entity has custom fields defined.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Overrides save to restrict non-admins from modifying other employee records, with permission checks.

methods.name: hasSaveAccess
methods.description: Determines if the current user has permission to save the employee record.

methods.name: setIsAdmin
methods.description: Resets the is_admin property based on current user's privileges.

methods.name: isUpdate
methods.description: Checks if the current operation is an update of an existing record.
